apis.name: USDA NASS Quick Stats
apis.why_notable: Authoritative US crop, livestock, and farm economics census/survey data with a free API key.

apis.name: USDA FoodData Central
apis.why_notable: Gold-standard nutrient composition database for foods and agricultural commodities.

apis.name: Open-Meteo Agricultural
apis.why_notable: Free weather API with soil temperature/moisture and crop-relevant variables, no key for non-commercial.

apis.name: Plant.id (Kindwise)
apis.why_notable: Image-based plant identification and disease diagnosis widely used in agtech apps.

apis.name: Trefle
apis.why_notable: Plant species encyclopedia API with taxonomy, growth habits, and distribution data.

apis.name: Perenual Plant API
apis.why_notable: Plant care, species, and hardiness data with a generous free tier for gardening apps.

apis.name: GBIF
apis.why_notable: Global biodiversity occurrence API for wild and cultivated plant/animal distribution.

apis.name: iNaturalist
apis.why_notable: Citizen-science observations of plants, pests, and wildlife useful for ecological ag context.

apis.name: OpenAQ
apis.why_notable: Air quality data often paired with agricultural exposure and crop stress analysis.

apis.name: FAOSTAT (FAO)
apis.why_notable: UN FAO global production, trade, and food-security statistics for countries and commodities.

apis.name: World Bank Climate Data API
apis.why_notable: Historical and projected climate indicators used in agricultural risk modeling.

apis.name: NOAA Climate Data Online
apis.why_notable: Station weather and climate normals critical for growing-degree-day and frost risk apps.

apis.name: USDA ERS Data
apis.why_notable: Economic Research Service APIs for farm income, commodities, and food markets.

apis.name: SoilGrids (ISRIC)
apis.why_notable: Global soil property maps (texture, pH, carbon) via REST for precision-ag planning.

apis.name: Agromonitoring (OpenWeather)
apis.why_notable: Satellite NDVI, soil, and weather for farm polygons; free tier with signup.

apis.name: NASA POWER
apis.why_notable: NASA agroclimatology parameters (solar, temp, precip) by lat/lon for crop models.

apis.name: FishWatch (NOAA)
apis.why_notable: US seafood species profiles and sustainability data for fisheries apps.

apis.name: Open Food Facts
apis.why_notable: Crowdsourced product/agri-food database spanning ingredients and origins.

apis.name: EPPO Global Database API
apis.why_notable: Pest and plant pathogen codes and taxonomy used across plant health systems.

apis.name: Kindwise Insect.id
apis.why_notable: Image-based insect/pest identification for IPM and livestock-adjacent pest apps.
